description: End-to-end lifecycle for managing SD-WAN service incidents for B2B customers, from detection and triage through remediation, change, communication, and closure.

tenant_id.description: Unique identifier of the enterprise customer (tenant)

site_id.description: Unique identifier of a customer site/location

wan_edge_id.description: Identifier of SD-WAN edge device (CPE/branch router)

service_id.description: Identifier of an SD-WAN virtual service (e.g., virtual circuit, overlay, QoS policy set)

change_request_id.description: Unique identifier for a change request related to an incident

task_id.description: Unique identifier for a work item or subtask associated with an incident

user_ref.description: Reference to a user (operator, NOC engineer, customer contact)

role.description: Role or function of the user

metrics.description: Key/value metrics from the test (latency_ms, loss_pct, jitter_ms, etc.)

evidence.description: Evidence artifacts such as logs or trace IDs

reference.description: URL or opaque reference to the artifact

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action and from where.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the IAM system.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization scope, if applicable.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: detect_sd_wan_incident
functions.description: Detect or register a new SD-WAN service incident from alarms, telemetry, or manual report.

correlation_key.description: Correlation identifier from alarm or external system to deduplicate events

detected_at.description: When the issue was first observed; defaults to now if omitted

attachments.description: Optional supporting artifacts at detection time

functions.returns: New or correlated incident record with incident_id, initial classification, and detection metadata.

functions.name: classify_sd_wan_incident
functions.description: Classify and prioritize an incident, including impact, affected objects, and routing to the right support queue.

sub_category.description: More granular type within the main category, free-form or taxonomy-specific

id.description: Identifier of the entity (according to type)

assignment.description: Assignment to a team or engineer

functions.returns: Updated incident classification, impact, and assignment details.

functions.name: run_sd_wan_diagnostics
functions.description: Run automated diagnostics for a given incident and associated SD-WAN components.

tests.description: List of diagnostic tests to run

prefer_overlay.description: Prefer SD-WAN overlay path where applicable

functions.returns: Diagnostic session with test IDs, initial status, and (for synchronous mode) results for each test.

functions.name: get_sd_wan_diagnostics_result
functions.description: Retrieve results of previously run SD-WAN diagnostic tests for an incident.

test_ids.description: Specific test IDs to retrieve; if omitted, returns latest for incident

include_raw_outputs.description: Whether to include raw command outputs/log snippets

functions.returns: Collection of diagnostic_result objects with optional raw evidence for each requested test.

functions.name: propose_sd_wan_remediation
functions.description: Generate or register a remediation plan for an incident, optionally requiring a change request.

actions.description: Ordered list of remediation actions to execute

candidate_config_id.description: Reference to a candidate configuration template/version

requires_change_request.description: Whether this step must be governed by a formal change request

customer_impact.description: Expected customer impact during this action

notes.description: Additional notes or rationale for the plan

functions.returns: Remediation plan with internal identifier, linkage to incident, and indication if change_request is required.

functions.name: create_sd_wan_change_request
functions.description: Create a formal change request linked to an incident and remediation plan.

external_reference.description: Optional reference to external change system (e.g., ServiceNow ID)

functions.returns: Created change request with change_request_id, status (e.g., pending_approval), and linkage to incident.

functions.name: execute_sd_wan_remediation
functions.description: Execute remediation actions for an incident, optionally under an approved change request, with rollback options.

execution_mode.description: Whether to simulate, run a subset of actions, or all actions

steps.description: Specific remediation steps to execute; if empty, uses full plan

override_parameters.description: Optional overrides for parameters defined in the plan

pre_checks.description: Checks that must pass before execution

functions.returns: Execution report with per-step status, any applied rollbacks, and updated incident state.

functions.name: rollback_sd_wan_change
functions.description: Perform a targeted rollback of SD-WAN changes associated with an incident or change request.

steps.description: Specific remediation steps to rollback, if known

entities.description: Entities whose configurations should be rolled back

reason.description: Reason for rollback (e.g., regression, customer request)

force.description: If true, attempt rollback even if change is not fully tracked

functions.returns: Rollback execution summary with list of reverted items, any failures, and updated incident/change status.

functions.name: update_sd_wan_incident_status
functions.description: Update status, state transitions, and resolution details for an SD-WAN incident.

resolution.description: Resolution details, required when status is resolved or cancelled

permanent_fix.description: Description of permanent remediation (if different from quick fix)

known_error_record_id.description: Link to knowledge base / problem record

hold_reason.description: Reason for putting incident on hold

customer_visible_state.description: Simplified state presented to customer portal

metadata_updates.description: Free-form metadata or tags to update

functions.returns: Updated incident record with new status, resolution details, and timestamps for state transition.

functions.name: notify_sd_wan_incident_stakeholders
functions.description: Send notifications and updates about an incident to internal and external stakeholders.

custom_message.description: Optional custom message body to override template content

attachments.description: Optional attachments or links for the notification

functions.returns: Notification dispatch report including per-channel status, failures, and message identifiers.

functions.name: list_sd_wan_incidents
functions.description: Search and list SD-WAN incidents with filtering, pagination, and sorting.

text_search.description: Free-text search across title, description, and notes

functions.returns: Paginated list of incidents with summary fields and optional aggregate counts by status/severity.

functions.name: retry_sd_wan_action
functions.description: Retry a failed automation or workflow action related to an SD-WAN incident, with override options.

scheduled_for.description: When to perform retry if mode=scheduled

override_parameters.description: Optional parameters to override for the task being retried

functions.returns: Retry job details including new task_id, status, and planned execution time.

functions.name: get_sd_wan_incident_timeline
functions.description: Retrieve the full lifecycle timeline for an SD-WAN incident, including state changes, diagnostics, changes, and communications.

include.description: Types of timeline entries to include

functions.returns: Ordered list of timeline events providing a full audit trail of the incident lifecycle.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import sd wan incident entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many sd wan incident entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many sd wan incident entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_bulk_export
functions.description: Export sd wan incident entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across sd wan incident entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for sd wan incident events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for sd wan incident notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more sd wan incident entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to sd wan incident on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a sd wan incident operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending sd wan incident change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending sd wan incident approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a sd wan incident entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a sd wan incident entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a sd wan incident entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a sd wan incident entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for sd wan incident activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a sd wan incident view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to sd wan incident entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given sd wan incident payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a sd wan incident entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: sd_wan_incident_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a sd wan incident entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
